cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You showed me the rescue dog's photo, not the page saying he eats sofas.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I understand. Admit that hiding the sofa page changed my yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Before we feed him another one, say I should have had both pages.
